justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/compiler/ICompiler.java and CompilerJava.java, CompilerGroovy.java, CompilerKotlin.java, CompilerScala.java, CompilerJRuby.java, CompilerJavaScript.java. These classes only depend on org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.process.AbstractProcess/IExternalProcess, org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.logger.ILogListener, and core JITWatchConstants; the package is directly used by jvmlang/LanguageManager.java and process/runtime/RuntimeKotlin.java (plus two tests). The observed dependencies point to central, widely reused packages rather than to less stable ones, so I did not find an unstable-dependency smell here.
